day.headline: A Rooster day — Ox and Snake are in step.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Past you laid it out. Trust her, wear it, go.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Shut it behind you like you meant it. Then go.

reasons: Dragon pairs with Rooster — a harmonious day
signs.message: Dark by seven now. Get outside while it's still gold.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the total that does not add up
signs.message: That total's off by a lot. Flag it today, calmly.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Air's gone heavy. Do the walk now, before it turns.

reasons: Ox and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Park up top, skip the crawl. Worth the extra flight.

reasons: Snake and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the cheaper version that works fine
signs.message: The cheap one's worked for months. Buy it again, no shame.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Delete forty near-identical photos. Ten minutes, problem gone.

reasons: Rabbit opposes Rooster — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Saturday's wide open. Keep it that way, no plans required.

reasons: Rooster's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: posture at the end of the day
signs.message: You're folded into your chair again. Lie flat, stay in.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The hallway nod is a whole relationship. Leave it there.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the person you owe an answer
signs.message: They can wait one more day. Answer when you actually mean it.
